effect_connectivity.criterion: Two comparisons, both reported. Per-sample: does removing the effect move the terminal voltage by more than one sigma of sensor noise. At the estimator: does removing it move the least-squares resistance by more than the smallest magnitude on the grid. The second is the one that decides whether the effect can change a verdict; the first is included because a reader will look for it and because an effect that fails BOTH is not present in any useful sense.

integration_path.note: the prior simulator uses x += dt/tau*(target-x); these plants use the exact zero-order-hold step. The two are different numerical methods, not two spellings of one.
